description: Validation harness that tests deployment DRYness by performing a clean deployment (destroy + apply) and verifying the RPC API starts without manual kubectl commands. Tests include helm chart validation, ConfigMap creation, pod startup, environment variables, JWT secret configuration, and API health checks.
expectedBehavior: PASS if all 8 tests pass: (1) Helm chart has required templates and values, (2) Clean deployment succeeds, (3) ConfigMap created automatically, (4) Pod reaches Running state without CrashLoopBackOff, (5) ENVIRONMENT variable set from values, (6) JWT_SECRET_KEY in ConfigMap, (7) API responds to health check, (8) Zero manual steps validation meta-test passes
